fact: Councillor Mohamed Mansaray was charged and appeared in Pademba Road Court No. 6 on two counts of cyberstalking and cyberbullying under ss. 44(1)(b) and 44(2)(b) of the Cybersecurity and Crime Act 2021, for conduct between 1 and 10 November 2025.
title: Councillor Charged to Court for Alleged Cyberbullying of Member of Parliament
